$comment: What the generator (scripts/spec/spec-generate-core.ts) adds to the vendored ESI OpenAPI document. `paths` holds operations ESI serves but does not list in its spec, in OpenAPI form; each must also be listed in esi-endpoint-exceptions.json, and the generator fails once the spec lists the path itself. `deprecations` maps the operationId of an operation the spec marks deprecated to its migration guidance (message, replacedBy, sunsetDate), carried into OperationMeta.deprecation; the generator fails on an entry whose operation is missing or not deprecated.
